newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH BANK CSOB SAYS CUTS PRIME RATE.
newsitem.headline: CZECH BANK CSOB SAYS CUTS PRIME RATE.

text.p: Czech bank Ceskoslovenska Obchodni Banka a.s. said on Friday it would cut its prime lending rate by by 50 basis points to 12.05 percent from 12.55 percent, effective October 1.
The bank said in a statement that it would also lower its base lending rate for one year credit to 12.30 percent from 12.80 percent.
CSOB is controlled by the Czech and Slovak central banks and government institutions. It is one of the four largest Czech banking houses.
The Czech National Bank increased the discount rate to 10.5 percent from 9.5 percent in June in order to reduce fast-growing money supply and inflation.
Most large banks have increased their lending rates since then.
